avis.titre: Finally Found My Holy Grail Milky Toner for Dry, Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I have been searching forever for a milky toner that combines tea tree and ceramides to finish off my hydrating toner step in my morning routine, and I think I finally found the one. I have used up at least 3 bottles and it delivers consistent results. This toner is lightweight, applies easily, and creates the perfect base before layering on treatment serums, moisturizer, and SPF. Living in a dry climate, milky toners are essential for me, and this one delivers hydration without feeling heavy. I especially love the addition of tea tree for its antibacterial and antioxidant benefits. It also helps calm down any irritation I get from occasional over-exfoliation or just dealing with dry, sensitive skin. The ceramides add that extra barrier support my skin really appreciates. I still enjoy the TirTir milky toner, but if you’re looking for something more tea tree-focused with a simpler ingredient profile, this one absolutely hits the spot. Best of all, it leaves my skin feeling hydrated—not sticky, greasy, or oily. If you have dry skin, live in a dry climate, or want a lightweight milky toner that supports your skin barrier while keeping irritation in check, this one is definitely worth trying.

avis.titre: Lightweight and excellent hydration before makeupLightweight and excellent hydration before makeup
avis.texte: I really like this essence from Innisfree. I use it as part of my skincare routine before applying makeup, and it leaves my face feeling hydrated, soft, and very fresh. It absorbs quickly, doesn't feel sticky, and helps my makeup apply more evenly. Plus, it’s gentle on my skin and keeps it hydrated throughout the day. It is definitely a product I would buy again. 😊

I’ve been using this for a couple months and I can definitely tell a difference in my skin. It’s brighter and softer and has stayed moisturized longer. Super lightweight and feels great on the skin. Definitely will be buying again when I run out!

I absolutely love this stuff. It’s light and absorbs very well into the skin. I like to apply it with clean, bare hands. No greasy feel, and is very moisturizing. Absolutely love it. I had first gotten it through an IPSY bag and had to purchase. Go ahead and get the big bottle. It’ll last a while!

This toner is one of the best I’ve ever used. The milkiness is ultra hydrating and barrier repairing. It is not greasy and has helped my skin appearance immensely. To me it is worth every dollar and decently priced.
Affordable, effective, luxurious, & gentle!! I will be repurchasing!!
I have such sensitive, acne-prone skin and this product has done nothing but wonders! Makes my face look super glowy. Definitely worth it, I’m on my second bottle now.

avis.titre: Lightweight and great for sensitive skin.
avis.texte: Really lovely! It's not as thick as the Rhode milky toner but this is probably the best runner up! You can also do two thin layers of this for a more hydrated result. Doesn't irritate my skin or leave it greasy at all.

Amazing, just as good as the glazing milk and love the refillable options. Very hydrating if you have normal-dry skin. Hasn't broken me out and a little goes a long way for sure. Wish there was something out there like this but for body lotion lol

I'd been wanting this product for months, but Sephora was always out of stock. So glad I found it on Amazon. I love how hydrating it is, and it's been a great addition to my skincare routine. I'll definitely be buying it again.

Amazing how well this Milk will soften the skin. It is a very lightweight consistency, almost water like, but has a slight creamy content about it. No scent that I can tell, so it won't get in the way of your perfumes. After using this the first time I could tell that it was doing something good, but after a week is where the results really come thru. Skin is softer, more supple, radiant. Absorbs quickly and no greasy residue. All said, this is a product that exceeds expectations and the value is right there.

Being fully vested in Korean skincare but who usually keeps skincare simple, I like this innisfree Green Tea Ceramide Milk. innisfree products have always been a hit with my family, and enjoyed all of their Green Tea lineup over the last decade since we discovered this brand while traveling in South Korea. And as a mature male, I greatly appreciate that it has no scent and makes my skin feel good. The texture is light and absorbs quick, but it still gives enough moisture to make my skin feel comfortable throughout the day. I like that it isn't watery, rather a little thick so I can better control the amount coming out of the bottle. I use it after washing my face and shaving, and then before bed because my skin tends to get dry and tight, especially around my cheeks. Green tea and ceramide based skincare products are commonly used to help support hydration and strengthen the skin barrier, which is great because I am now in my 40s. But it should be good for all ages in my opinion. In summary, it calms my skin without being fragranced. It layers well with serums and sunscreen during the day and does not make my face look shiny. After a couple weeks, my skin definitely feels less dry and felt smoother overall. It may not be some dramatic miracle product, but for everyday hydration and keeping irritation down, it has been a solid replacement and great investment in my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Chuffed over noticeable difference in 24 hours!
avis.texte: I was previously using The Face Shop's Rice & Ceramide toner alongside several other products in my routine. I apply 0.25% tretinoin cream at night, and unfortunately, that old toner wasn't helping at all — in fact, it seemed to make things worse. Even when I skipped the tretinoin and used an exfoliating cleanser instead, my skin still felt dry and under-moisturised. I later realised the culprit was alcohol denat. high up in the ingredients list, which can be drying and irritating, especially with actives like tretinoin. That's when I switched to this Innisfree Green Tea Ceramide Milk (it's more of a milky essence/toner hybrid), and honestly, I can't believe the difference! When I first patted a bit onto the back of my hand, I thought it must be an essence mislabelled as a toner — the texture is luxuriously creamy yet lightweight, glides on smoothly, and absorbs instantly. My skin felt noticeably smoother straight away, almost like it did in my teens! No redness, no irritation, no itchiness at all. A little really does go a long way — no need for cotton pads; just pat it in with your hands. What stands out most is the serious hydration power. It contains multiple forms of hyaluronic acid (Hyaluronic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, and Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate) — that's five or six variants alone, which penetrate different skin layers for immediate plumpness and longer-term moisture retention. It visibly reduces those

I’ve been really enjoying this milky toner. The texture is lightweight but still feels very hydrating, and it absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving behind any sticky or greasy feeling. My skin immediately feels softer and more moisturized after applying it, and it gives a nice healthy glow that works really well as a prep step before the rest of my skincare or makeup. What stands out most to me is how hydrating it feels. The combination of green tea, ceramides, and multiple types of hyaluronic acid seems to really help lock in moisture and support my skin barrier. My skin tends to lean a bit sensitive at times, and this toner feels very gentle and soothing. I also appreciate that it’s non-comedogenic and tested on acne-prone skin, because I’m always cautious about products that might clog pores or trigger breakouts. So far it has worked well for my skin and hasn’t caused any irritation. Another nice bonus is how well it layers with other products. It creates a smooth base that helps the rest of my skincare absorb nicely, and it pairs well with stronger actives like retinol without feeling heavy. Overall, this is a great everyday toner if you’re looking for something hydrating, gentle, and lightweight that still leaves your skin looking fresh and glowy. There is no scent and almost as a slight cooling effect. It’s a simple step that makes a noticeable difference in how hydrated and balanced my skin feels.

I have never tried a milky toner and now I am a converted fan. The texture of this toner is light weight and watery-like. The color is milky white. The toner spreads easily on the skin and absorbs quickly. My skin does not feel greasy or sticky. It feels calming and soothing without any harshness. It feels very gentle and hydrating. I like the inclusion of green tea ceramide and hyaluronic acid in the toner which further boost hydration. This toner does an excellent job of prepping the face for serum and night cream. This is an amazing toner that I highly recommend.

avis.titre: Lightweight but Very Hydrating – Great Value for the Price
avis.texte: My skin gets very dry during the winter, and lately I’ve been dealing with a lot of dehydration under the surface. Using just a moisturizer didn’t feel like enough, so I decided to try this Innisfree Green Tea Ceramide Milk Essence after a friend recommended it. The texture is milky and lightweight, and it spreads very smoothly over the skin. It absorbs nicely while still leaving my skin feeling soft and well hydrated. After applying it, my skin feels instantly more moisturized without feeling heavy or greasy, which makes it perfect for everyday use. I also like that it contains ceramides. My skin feels stronger and healthier, and it seems less sensitive to dryness than before. The subtle green tea scent is another plus—it’s fresh and pleasant without being overpowering. For the price, the performance is really impressive. It provides great hydration and makes my skin feel much more comfortable during dry seasons. I think it’s a great value and definitely worth trying.

avis.titre: My Dry Skin Feels So Much Better
avis.texte: I ordered this innisfree Green Tea Ceramide Milk Toner because I like Korean skincare products very much. Overall, I have found them hydrating for my dry skin, and this toner is no different. The bottle arrived boxed, and the lid had a secure safety seal. This beautiful white toner is not as runny as other toners I've tried, especially if you give it a good shake before use. This can be poured into my hand and then applied gently to my face. I then like to wipe the remainder onto my hands, and they now feel nice and look a little younger, too. You can also use a cotton pad for application if you prefer. When applying, this toner soaks in quickly, makes my skin feel cool, and instantly moisturizes and hydrates. I love that there isn't any initial stickiness, just smooth, soft skin. This toner has a well-formulated ingredient list, particularly excellent for dry, dehydrated, sensitive, or mature skin, or for repairing a damaged skin barrier. Apparently, I am the poster girl (well, senior!) for this toner! I like the high hydration and skin-barrier support, using well-regarded, safe ingredients, as often seen in K-beauty. I'm glad I found this green tea milky toner, and for me, it is a good value for the price.

I love this brand and their products! I have tried many of their items and from sunscreens to lotions, I really enjoy everything. This milk toner is very hydrating compared to other toners I've used. It looks very milky and shiny when squeezed out of the bottle, but it dries quite matte. It is lightweight and looks natural and not like you have anything smeared or dried onto your skin. There is no scent that I can detect, which is a plus. I use a retinol on my face each night before bed and this is soothing and helps with any flaking I might have in the morning. It is smooth under my sunscreen and makeup and has not created any issue with makeup lasting during the day. My skin is extremely oily and while this does not stop the oil coming through, it does not increase it as some toners can. It does not dry my skin out and I like it for the soothing effects and helping with my skins barrier.

avis.titre: innisfree Green Tea Ceramide Milk toner
avis.texte: After using this toner, my skin feels very hydrated. My face usually feels extremely tight after cleansing, but as soon as I apply this toner, it absorbs quickly and helps reduce that tight feeling right away. It has excellent moisturizing power and gives my skin a natural glow. It’s also very easy to use, and when I have more time, I like to soak a cotton pad with it and leave it on my skin—it makes my face feel deeply hydrated and refreshed. If you’re looking for a lightweight, refreshing toner with great quality for the price, I would definitely recommend it.👍👍

This toner is super milky. I usually just use my fingers to put it on my face because it simply slides off of the cotton panda that I usually use. It’s one of the best toners that I’ve had though. Doesn’t leave my skin feeling tight or irritated at all!

This essence works well on my face. It's light and easy to spread around. My face quickly absorbs it. I use this after a separate toner and before the ampoule. It has a nice light fragrance and doesn't irritate my skin. My face feels so smooth afterwards. I enjoy using this in my full skincare routine.

This is a great toner. I have combination skin that tends to be on the dry side. This toner is perfect for my skin. I squeeze out the toner onto my fingers and then simply apply it. There's zero stickiness, and it easily absorbs. It also leaves my skin feeling hydrated and plump all day. I really love how healthy this makes my skin feel and look.

This toner feels really gentle and nourishing on my skin. I use it right after cleansing and let it air dry after spreading it on my face. There is no white cast or any visible residue left after it dries. I like the slight cooling effect it has on my skin. Definitely one of my new favorite toners which I will likely repurchase when it runs out.

Absolutely adore this refreshing milk that splashes on like a toner but hydrates like an ampoule/serum. Unscented and doesn’t leave skin sticky. Excellent after application of tretinoin type creams that can leave skin try. I use it twice a day and love how lightweight it is. Laced skin bright and glowing without being shiny. Perfect!
